summary: Make GPU isolation and trust boundaries explicit for shared services without assuming that scheduling policy alone protects data.
outcomes: Identify device, process, container and tenant trust boundaries.
Design least-privilege access and safe handling of buffers and telemetry.
sequence: Map a shared inference service and its data flows.
Separate resource sharing from security guarantees.
Review device access, image provenance and supported isolation modes.
Consider stale buffers, exported handles and sensitive profiling data.
Plan patching, audit and incident containment using vendor guidance.

visual.question: Which component can access this memory handle or profiling artifact?
visual.interaction: Trace access paths and compare documented isolation modes.

practice.task: Threat-model a fictional multi-tenant GPU service.
practice.success: Each mitigation is tied to a specific threat and verified capability; residual assumptions remain visible.
